rules.rule: Verify command authorization, execution fence, MQTT commit-point ordering, readback verification, device control-group freeze, and reply-recovery queue invariants per docs/adr/ and modules/command/pkg/commandformal. Flag state-machine changes that require rerunning `npm run command:formal`.

Registered migrations are frozen: flag any modification to an existing migration instead of adding a new migration. New tables or schemas must include Chinese `COMMENT ON` statements and avoid temporary or backup table names.

Enforce single-owner data ownership per contracts/: only the owning module may mutate its domain tables. Verify OpenAPI/generated contract alignment and gateway authz/tenant-scope checks on added or changed endpoints.

Verify PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md invariants that static gates do not check: never render 0 or normal for unknown/disconnected metrics, never fabricate fallback values, keep URL/Query/Form/local state in their owning layers, and compute business dates in site timezone rather than browser local time.
